48.0.en: [[spring:Spring]] [[courtship:courtship]] songs filled the air before tiny chicks began to [[hatch:hatch]] in boxes.
48.0.zh: 春天求偶的歌声四处飘荡，不久小雏鸟就开始在箱子里破壳。

48.1.en: A [[quiet:quiet]] duck settled down to [[brood:brood]] while trout started to [[spawn:spawn]] in the pool.
48.1.zh: 一只安静的鸭子伏下来孵蛋，鳟鱼则开始在水池里产卵。

48.2.en: A young bird looked almost [[mature:mature]] but still had a cut on one sharp little [[claw:claw]].
48.2.zh: 一只幼鸟看上去快要成年了，可锋利的小爪子上还有一道伤口。

48.3.en: Leo cleaned a soft [[paw:paw]] with warm water and gently mended a split in a bird's [[beak:beak]].
48.3.zh: 里奥用温水清洗柔软的爪子，还轻轻修补了一只鸟喙上的裂口。

48.4.en: They checked a torn [[fin:fin]] on a trout and a weak little [[wing:wing]] on a duck.
48.4.zh: 他们检查了鳟鱼身上撕裂的鳍，和鸭子那侧无力的小翅膀。

48.5.en: A loose grey [[plume:plume]] fell softly, and Leo saved each tiny brown [[feather:feather]] for study.
48.5.zh: 一根松软的灰色大羽毛轻轻落下，里奥把每根棕色小羽毛都收起来做研究。

49.0.en: A piglet raised its stiff [[bristle:bristle]] coat, then slept in a snug warm [[curl:curl]].
49.0.zh: 小猪竖起硬硬的鬃毛，然后蜷成暖暖的一团睡着了。

49.1.en: They counted each buzzing [[insect:insect]] near the flowers and moved a pink [[worm:worm]] off the path.
49.1.zh: 他们数着花边嗡嗡叫的昆虫，还把一条粉色蠕虫挪到路边。

49.2.en: They removed a [[destructive:destructive]] garden [[pest:pest]] by hand and washed off a tiny leaf [[parasite:parasite]] too.
49.2.zh: 他们用手捉走破坏菜园的害虫，还洗掉了叶子上小小的寄生虫。

49.3.en: A small striped [[spider:spider]] hung in the corner while loud green [[cricket:crickets]] sang outdoors.
49.3.zh: 一只条纹小蜘蛛挂在角落，外面响亮的大绿蟋蟀在歌唱。

49.4.en: They helped an old tired [[seal:seal]] rest and lifted heavy sleepy [[tortoise:tortoises]] into the shade.
49.4.zh: 他们扶着疲惫的老海豹休息，又把沉重的瞌睡陆龟抬进阴凉处。

49.5.en: A baby sea [[turtle:turtle]] swam in circles while distant huge [[whale:whales]] sang low songs.
49.5.zh: 一只海龟宝宝绕着圈游泳，远处巨大的鲸群低声吟唱。

50.0.en: A jumping [[kangaroo:kangaroo]] ate fresh leaves while traders once stole white [[ivory:ivory]] for money.
50.0.zh: 蹦跳的袋鼠吃着鲜叶，而商人们曾为钱财偷取白色象牙。

50.1.en: They polished a curved antelope [[horn:horn]] model and heard a far lonely [[wolf:wolves]] howl at [[night:night]].
50.1.zh: 他们擦亮弯曲的羚羊角模型，听见远处孤独的狼群在夜里嚎叫。

50.2.en: A Komodo [[dragon:dragon]] slept behind glass while quick red [[fox:foxes]] sniffed the morning air.
50.2.zh: 科莫多巨蜥在玻璃后酣睡，敏捷的红狐狸嗅着清晨的空气。

50.3.en: Leo broke square food [[cube:cubes]] into bits and gave one to a thirsty spotted [[calf:calf]].
50.3.zh: 里奥把方形饲料块掰碎，分一块给干渴的斑点小牛犊。

50.4.en: A wet newborn [[pup:pup]] shivered in towels while a soft white [[lamb:lamb]] drank warm milk.
50.4.zh: 湿漉漉的新生幼犬在毛巾里发抖，软软的白色小羊羔喝着温奶。

50.5.en: The [[quiet:quiet]] milk [[cattle:cattle]] stood in line while a strong brown [[ox:oxen]] pulled a dray.
50.5.zh: 安静的奶牛排成一列，强壮的棕色公牛拉着运货车。

51.0.en: A loud angry [[bull:bull]] stamped its feet while a calm grey [[buffalo:buffalo]] chewed long [[grass:grass]].
51.0.zh: 愤怒的公牛大声跺脚，平静的灰水牛慢慢嚼着长草。

51.1.en: Leo brushed a tall brown [[horse:horse]] gently and waved at a calm striped [[zebra:zebra]] nearby.
51.1.zh: 里奥轻轻刷着高大的棕马，向旁边温顺的条纹斑马挥手。

51.2.en: A kind grey [[donkey:donkey]] carried light bags while Leo cleaned a worn leather [[saddle:saddle]] nearby.
51.2.zh: 和善的灰驴驮着轻袋子，里奥在旁边擦拭磨旧的皮马鞍。

51.3.en: A fast grey [[falcon:falcon]] circled high above while a sharp-eyed [[hawk:hawk]] waited in a tree.
51.3.zh: 迅捷的灰隼在高空盘旋，目光锐利的鹰在树上等候。

51.4.en: A stately bald [[eagle:eagle]] sat very still while a sleepy brown [[owl:owl]] blinked in the dark.
51.4.zh: 威严的白头海雕静静坐着，瞌睡的棕色猫头鹰在暗处眨眼。

51.5.en: A tiny hungry [[sparrow:sparrow]] pecked at seeds while a mild grey [[pigeon:pigeon]] drank clean water.
51.5.zh: 小小的饿麻雀啄着种子，温顺的灰鸽子喝着清水。

52.0.en: A black noisy [[crow:crow]] hopped near the railing while a white calm [[swan:swan]] floated on the water.
52.0.zh: 黑色吵闹的乌鸦在栏杆边跳跃，白色安静的天鹅浮在水面上。

52.1.en: A white farm [[goose:goose]] honked for [[feed:feed]] while a red stately [[cock:cock]] strutted in the yard.
52.1.zh: 农场的白鹅嘎嘎叫着要吃的，神气的红公鸡在院子里阔步。

52.2.en: A tiny brown [[mouse:mouse]] hid under [[straw:straw]] while quick grey [[rat:rats]] ran behind the door.
52.2.zh: 小小的棕老鼠藏在稻草下，敏捷的灰老鼠跑到门后去了。

52.3.en: A quick red [[squirrel:squirrel]] climbed the oak while a shy brown [[hare:hare]] sat in the clover.
52.3.zh: 敏捷的红松鼠爬上橡树，害羞的棕野兔坐在三叶草丛里。

52.4.en: A little green [[frog:frog]] jumped near the gutter, showing calm, watchful [[behaviour:behaviour]].
52.4.zh: 一只小绿青蛙跳到排水沟边，一副镇定又警觉的样子。

52.5.en: Leo learned that deep [[bite:bites]] could ache and a bee [[sting:sting]] could [[puff:puff]] up fast.
52.5.zh: 里奥了解到，深深的咬伤会疼，蜜蜂蜇过的地方会很快肿起来。

53.0.en: Dogs gave a short warning [[bark:bark]] at [[first:first]], then a lion gave a low, sleepy [[roar:roar]].
53.0.zh: 狗先发出短促的警告吠叫，接着狮子发出低沉而困倦的吼声。

53.1.en: Leo did not [[rub:rub]] his eyes in the [[dust:dust]] and did not [[creep:creep]] close to the fences.
53.1.zh: 里奥不在灰尘里揉眼睛，也不悄悄凑近围栏。

53.2.en: The children learned to [[crawl:crawl]] low under the ropes and respect the [[natural:natural]] [[habitat:habitats]] around them.
53.2.zh: 孩子们学会压低身子从绳下爬过，尊重身边的每一处天然栖息地。

53.3.en: The [[hive:hive]] was protected and the [[nest:nest]] left undisturbed.
53.3.zh: 蜂箱得到了保护，鸟巢也没有被惊扰。

53.4.en: No [[cage:cage]] was used and the [[cell:cells]] remained open.
53.4.zh: 没有用到任何笼子，那个小隔间也一直敞开着。

53.5.en: The [[barn:barn]] stood [[stable:stable]] and the [[stable:stable]] doors stayed open.
53.5.zh: 谷仓稳稳立着，马厩的门也一直敞开着。

53.6.en: These small frogs seem [[ubiquitous:ubiquitous]] near water all through spring.
53.6.zh: 整个春天，这些小青蛙在水边好像无处不在。

53.7.en: The teacher showed us a tiny [[mite:mite]] under the glass.
53.7.zh: 老师把一只很小的螨放在玻璃片下给我们看。

53.8.en: That old lion stayed [[elusive:elusive]], so nobody took a photo of it.
53.8.zh: 那头老狮子行踪难觅，所以没人拍到它的照片。

54.0.en: They trimmed a low green [[hedge:hedge]] by the path and painted the [[wooden:wooden]] [[barrier:barrier]] at the gate.
54.0.zh: 他们修剪了路边低低的绿树篱，还给大门旁的木栅栏刷了漆。

54.1.en: A vet explained basic bird [[anatomy:anatomy]] charts and warned them about the year of the poultry [[epidemic:epidemic]].
54.1.zh: 兽医讲解了基础的鸟类解剖挂图，还提醒他们留意家禽流行病暴发的那一年。

54.2.en: They learned how one tiny change in a [[gene:gene]] could leave a weak bird carrying a hidden [[germ:germ]] inside its body.
54.2.zh: 他们了解到，基因上一处小小的改变，就可能让一只体弱的鸟体内藏着看不见的病菌。

54.3.en: The lab found harmless mouth [[bacteria:bacteria]] in samples and no dangerous winter [[virus:virus]] at all.
54.3.zh: 实验室在样本里只发现无害的口腔细菌，整个冬天都没有危险的病毒。

54.4.en: Each [[invisible:invisible]] [[microbe:microbe]] was logged, and slow winter [[metabolism:metabolism]] kept many snakes still.
54.4.zh: 每个看不见的微生物都被记录在案，冬天缓慢的新陈代谢让许多蛇一动不动。

54.5.en: They added high [[protein:protein]] beans to meals and extra orange [[vitamin:vitamin]] drops for the parrots.
54.5.zh: 他们在餐食里加了高蛋白豆子，还给鹦鹉加了橙色维生素滴剂。

55.0.en: Sick glands may [[secrete:secrete]] thick [[fluid:fluid]], while healthy kidneys [[excrete:excrete]] waste each day.
55.0.zh: 生病的腺体会分泌浓稠的液体，健康的肾脏则每天排出废物。

55.1.en: A hungry chick will quickly [[devour:devour]] its meal, guided by sharp [[night:night]] [[instinct:instinct]].
55.1.zh: 饥饿的雏鸟会凭敏锐的夜间本能，很快吞下食物。

55.2.en: Leo made an [[intuitive:intuitive]] guess about thirst and sensed the true healing [[potential:potential]] of rest.
55.2.zh: 里奥凭直觉猜到了口渴的原因，也感受到休息真正的治愈潜力。

55.3.en: The team praised his growing [[intelligence:intelligence]] and built a strong, [[functional:functional]] perch from logs.
55.3.zh: 团队夸他越来越聪明，还用圆木搭了一个结实实用的栖木。

55.4.en: The nurses stayed [[sensitive:sensitive]] to soft sounds and kept their handling calm and [[flexible:flexible]] for the shy birds.
55.4.zh: 护理员对细微的声响很敏感，对胆小的鸟儿总是又轻又稳地照料。

55.5.en: Bats use soft [[acoustic:acoustic]] echoes to move, while ducks need sharp [[optical:optical]] focus at [[dusk:dusk]].
55.5.zh: 蝙蝠靠柔和的声学回声行动，鸭子则在黄昏时需要敏锐的视觉聚焦。

56.0.en: Many bats are busy and [[nocturnal:nocturnal]] at [[night:night]], while toads stay sleepy and [[dormant:dormant]] by day.
56.0.zh: 许多蝙蝠在夜里忙碌、夜间活动，蟾蜍白天则昏昏欲睡地休眠。

56.1.en: Winter [[hibernation:hibernation]] ends slowly, so helpers [[track:track]] weight charts with great care.
56.1.zh: 冬眠慢慢结束，帮工们细心地追踪体重记录表。

56.2.en: They found no [[trace:trace]] of sickness in the water and took an [[alternate:alternate]] path back to base.
56.2.zh: 他们在水里没发现任何疾病的痕迹，便取了另一条备用小路回基地。

56.3.en: A weak rabbit becomes easy [[prey:prey]] when silent, hungry [[predator:predators]] wait nearby.
56.3.zh: 当悄无声息、饥肠辘辘的捕食者守在一旁时，体弱的兔子就成了轻易到手的猎物。

56.4.en: No small animal became a helpless [[victim:victim]] here, and no lonely [[captive:captive]] animal stayed sad for long.
56.4.zh: 这里没有小动物沦为无助的受害者，也没有哪只被圈养的动物会长时间闷闷不乐。

56.5.en: Staff had to stay calm and [[defensive:defensive]] around a nervous animal, and each newcomer must [[undergo:undergo]] a safety [[induction:induction]].
56.5.zh: 员工在容易紧张的动物旁边必须保持冷静并注意防护，每个新来的人都要先接受一次安全培训。

57.0.en: Old wounds still ache in the cold rain, so frail, elderly birds [[suffer:suffer]] and feel very [[vulnerable:vulnerable]] today.
57.0.zh: 旧伤在冷雨里还是会疼，虚弱的老年鸟儿因此很受罪，今天显得格外脆弱。

57.1.en: They grow beans for daily [[subsistence:subsistence]] and never try to [[exterminate:exterminate]] [[local:local]] snakes at all.
57.1.zh: 他们种豆子维持日常生计，也从不试图把当地的蛇赶尽杀绝。

57.2.en: Leo learned to [[tame:tame]] his own fright with patience while the kind chief [[keeper:keeper]] praised his work.
57.2.zh: 里奥学会用耐心驯服自己的恐惧，和善的首席饲养员夸他做得好。

57.3.en: At [[sunset:sunset]] a [[gentle:gentle]] old [[shepherd:shepherd]] visited with his dog and thanked every tired helper warmly.
57.3.zh: 日落时分，一位温和的老牧羊人带着狗前来看望，热情感谢每一位疲惫的帮工。

paraZh.48: 春天求偶孵雏，里奥检查爪子、鸟喙、鱼鳍与羽毛。
paraZh.50: 从袋鼠狐狸到牛犊幼犬，大家一一照看各种动物。
paraZh.51: 公牛水牛马斑马驴隼鹰猫头鹰，动物们各得其所。
paraZh.52: 乌鸦天鹅鹅公鸡松鼠青蛙，里奥学习咬伤与蜇伤。
paraZh.53: 听犬吠狮吼，学低姿爬行，守护蜂箱鸟巢与马厩谷仓。
paraZh.54: 修剪树篱刷栅栏，学习从解剖、基因病菌到维生素的护理知识。
paraZh.55: 学分泌排泄与本能直觉，搭栖木，悉心照料胆小鸟儿。
paraZh.56: 学夜行休眠冬眠，追踪猎物与受害圈养动物，接受安全培训。
paraZh.57: 雨天护弱鸟维生计，里奥驯服恐惧，老牧羊人道谢。
